details.description: Cogito 671B v2.1 is a 671-billion-parameter mixture-of-experts hybrid reasoning model (37B activated parameters) from Deep Cogito, forked from an open-licensed DeepSeek base checkpoint and released November 19, 2025 under an MIT license as a full release, following the company's earlier July 2025 'Cogito v2 preview' 671B model. It can answer directly like a standard LLM or first self-reflect in an extended reasoning mode, using Deep Cogito's Iterated Distillation and Amplification (IDA) training method. It is tuned for coding, STEM, instruction following, tool calling and general helpfulness, and Deep Cogito states it was trained in more than 30 languages.
advantages: Supports both a direct-answer mode and a self-reflective 'thinking' reasoning mode, per Deep Cogito's model card.
Supports single, parallel, multiple and parallel-multiple tool-calling configurations in both standard and extended-thinking mode, per Deep Cogito's model card.
Trained in more than 30 languages, per Deep Cogito's model card.
disadvantages: As a 671B-parameter model (about 1.3 TB in BF16), Deep Cogito states it requires at least 8 B200 or 16 H200 GPUs to run, per its Hugging Face model card.
use_cases: Tool calling / function calling in agentic applications

sources.title: Cogito 671B v2.1 API & Playground | Fireworks AI

notes: WRONG_MODEL correction: the researcher had identified 'p1' as the July 31, 2025 preview (cogito-v2-preview-deepseek-671B-MoE) by naming convention alone, since the exact catalog URI (accounts/fireworks/models/cogito-671b-v2-p1) 404s on Fireworks' site. Verification found the same slug live on Fireworks under Deep Cogito's own account (accounts/cogito/models/cogito-671b-v2-p1 -- no separate listing exists under the 'fireworks' account for this slug in Fireworks' own model search), titled 'Cogito 671B v2.1' with a context length of 163,840 tokens, an exact match for the catalog's facts. Rewrote the entry to describe Cogito v2.1 (a full release dated November 19, 2025, not a preview) instead of the earlier preview. Deep Cogito's own Hugging Face and GitHub pages for v2.1 state a 128,000-token context window, which still disagrees with the catalog's 163,840; kept the catalog's value per the research brief and flag the discrepancy here, since Fireworks' own listing for this exact model independently shows the same 163,840 figure. No numeric benchmark scores could be extracted from the model card or blog post beyond qualitative claims -- the underlying charts are images, so evaluations is left empty rather than guessed.
